rows.value: AMD B350

rows.label: Processeurs / socket
rows.value:
Supports AMD AM4 Socket for 3rd, 2nd and 1st Gen Ryzen/2nd and 1st Gen Ryzen with Radeon Vega
 
Graphics/Athlon with Radeon Vega Graphics/7th Gen A-Series/Athlon X4 Processors

rows.label: Mémoire
rows.value:
Supports Dual Channel DDR4 1866/2133/2400/2667/2933(OC)/3200(OC)
 
4 x DDR4 DIMM Memory Slot, Max. Supports up to 64 GB Memory
 
Each DIMM supports non-ECC 8/16 GB DDR4 module
 
* DDR4 - 2667 only for Ryzen CPU.
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for Memory support list.

rows.value:

Supports DX12

rows.label: Stockage et restrictions
rows.value:
4x SATA III Connector (6Gb/s) : Supports AHCI & RAID 0, 1, 10
 
1x M.2 (32Gb/s) : Supports PCI-E & SATA SSD
 
* M.2 (32Gb/s) : The bandwidth is depended on CPU, Ryzen is 32Gb/s ; APU is 16Gb/s.
* Specifications vary by CPU types

rows.label: Réseau filaire
rows.value:
Realtek RTL 8118AS
 
10/ 100/ 1000 Mb/s auto negotiation, Half / Full duplex capability
 
Support Super LAN Surge Protection

7.1 Channels, High Definition Audio, Hi-Fi(Front)

rows.label: USB
rows.value:
2x USB 3.1 Gen2 (10Gb/s) port (2 on rear I/Os)
 
6x USB 3.1 Gen1 (5Gb/s) port (4 on rear I/Os and 2 via internal headers)
 
4x USB 2.0 port (4 via internal headers)

rows.value:

1x PCIe 2.0 x16 Slot (x4)
